description: This file contains a Jupyter Notebook with Python code for a data retrieval and natural language processing pipeline. It demonstrates connecting to a PostgreSQL database, generating SQL queries from natural language questions using OpenAI's GPT models, executing these queries, and then generating natural language answers with GEMINI's language model. The notebook includes setup, prompt engineering, API calls, and responses handling for a knowledge-based question-answering system on an educational database schema.

methods.name: generate_prompt
methods.description: Constructs a detailed prompt combining user question and system instructions for SQL query generation.

methods.name: openai_model
methods.description: Sends a prompt to the OpenAI GPT API to generate a SQL query or response based on the task.

methods.name: get_query
methods.description: Extracts SQL query enclosed within ```sql code blocks from the model's output.

methods.name: get_data
methods.description: Executes a SQL query on the PostgreSQL database and retrieves all results.

methods.name: generate_final_prompt
methods.description: Creates a comprehensive prompt for the answer generator, including data, SQL query, and context.

methods.name: get_text_content
methods.description: Extracts text content from a GEMINI model response object.

methods.name: cost_counter
methods.description: Calculates the token-based cost of the prompts and responses for OpenAI models.
